northStar: Every Anchor session — interactive ConPTY or one-shot job — leaves an honest, machine-verified trail of what it cost and what it accomplished, so the project rollup's numbers mean 'measured truth, not zero-by-omission,' and clicking ANY session tile reliably opens a warm terminal that narrates what was done, what was produced, and what comes next.
criteria: Interactive PTY sessions capture real usage: a usage-capture seam on the terminal_session path (e.g. the engine's own session JSONL sidecar) produces a RUN-provenance effort with a real cost block (tokens/time/$), finalized on every end path (finish, kill, close/park, reconcile-dead) — verified by a STUB-GATE suite with a pinned sidecar fixture, and by one live smoke run whose rollup delta matches the sidecar's reported usage.

Honesty contract holds and is test-pinned: discovered/imported efforts still contribute exactly 0; a session whose usage genuinely cannot be captured surfaces an explicit 'unmeasured' state distinct from $0.00 in the rollup UI; no cost is ever estimated, interpolated, or fabricated — existing v4 rollup and v8 persist suites stay green unmodified.

No double-counting: a session's persisted docs (source=discovered) and its new RUN cost record coexist without inflating the rollup — dedup keyed on session_id proven by a test that persists docs AND attaches cost for the same session, asserting the rollup counts the cost exactly once.

The diag-B2 tile inconsistencies are REPRODUCED first (Playwright against captured registry-state fixtures: large-tile blank window, context-free blue restart, manual orientation), then fixed: after the fix, every tile class (running, parked-idle, done, failed, discovered/brownfield) click-opens a non-blank session window in Playwright with a screenshot sign-off.

Resume narrates and orients: clicking a parked/done/discovered tile starts a session whose read-only orientation prompt AUTO-EXECUTES (loads docs/summary and prints what was done / accomplished / produced / next steps in the terminal), while any mutating/ACTION prompt remains v10 paste-NOT-submit — the fork is resolved, locked in the North Star doc, and pinned by a test asserting no ACTION prompt is ever auto-submitted.

All constraints preserved: Python stdlib-only (pywinpty exception) passes distro.py's import scan; tests never touch the live :8777 service (stub PTY + ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD + fake sidecar fixtures); resume/advance tests follow the v11/v11.1 lessons (worktree-only, conversation-only seeds the stub PTY buffer); the daily healthcheck gains a stubbed walk of the new capture+finalize path.

The undercount is measured once: a before/after comparison on at least one real project quantifies how much spend the rollup was missing (turning derived-I1 from inferred to observed) and is recorded in the execution log.
summary: Seven phases ordered by hard dependency: (0) ground-truth spikes and decision locks gate the design; (1) durability substrate (atomic writes + fail-closed seam) lands before anything finalizes; (2) the narration backfill + passive warm tile view make 'any tile narrates' true immediately without waiting on cost work; (3) the usage-capture pipeline (UUID-at-launch, sum-over-message parser, append-only ledger, eager finalize) builds on the pinned spike fixture; (4) rollup honesty surfaces measured-truth vs explicit 'unmeasured' with dedup pinned by test; (5) live resume + tile reliability resolves the B2 classes and the orientation fork exactly as locked in Phase 0; (6) verification and deploy proves the whole trail live (healthcheck walk, drift tripwire, smoke run, one-week prospective capture-rate). Every phase maps to named North-Star criteria; Gemini-segment capture and any pricing table are the two explicitly deferred/forbidden items, named per phase rather than silently omitted.

phases.name: Phase 0 — Ground Truth, Reproductions, and Decision Locks
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (1),(4),(5),(6): the entire capture design is gated on the observed sidecar contract, the B2 fixes are gated on real reproductions, and the auto-execute fork must be locked before any wave can relitigate it. Nothing downstream is designed against guessed shapes.
nearTermSpecifics: B1 sidecar spike: run a REAL interactive claude PTY for 3 turns, kill it, diff the produced ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/*.jsonl against parser expectations; pin the observed shape (per-message usage blocks, session UUID line, resume markers) as tests/fixtures/sidecar/ canonical fixtures — the capture design in Phase 3 is frozen only after this spike's findings are written into the plan

Wave-0 closed-world test audit: enumerate every rollup/persist assertion in the v4 rollup and v8 persist suites; classify each additive-compatible (new cost source off-by-default in legacy fixtures via the ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR seam being unset) vs legitimately superseded, documented in the plan doc — no improvised rewrites later

Lock the fork as a written North Star doc amendment: orientation = auto-executed READ-ONLY narration via a one-shot plan-mode job_runner job (permission_mode='plan', like Gandalf shards) — or fully passive render if the spike shows plan-mode unenforceable on that path; ACTION prompts = v10 paste-NOT-submit, always
Registry-state fixture capture tool: a dev command that snapshots a project's live session_registry + effort store into an anonymized fixture dir, so B2 reproductions run against CAPTURED real states

B2 reproduction pass: Playwright against the REAL ConPTY backend + captured fixtures, reproduce large-tile blank window, context-free blue restart, and manual-orientation; classify each as state-bug (fixture-testable) vs attach-race (needs the WS attach-ack protocol change) and record the classification as separate plan items
deferred: Gemini CLI usage-capture spike (idea 30): explicitly a fast-follow — inventory gemini/agy telemetry files and UUID-at-launch feasibility AFTER this plan; the per-segment model in Phase 4 reserves the enum state for it but nothing here blocks on it
All fixes: Phase 0 reproduces and classifies only; no B2 fix code lands here

phases.name: Phase 1 — Durability Substrate (atomic writes + fail-closed sidecar seam)
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (1),(6): finalize-on-every-end-path is only honest if a crash mid-finalize cannot corrupt the registry/ledger (the 2026-07-08 architecture review's #1 bug), and tests/healthcheck must be physically unable to touch the live ~/.claude store — mirroring the never-8777 guard.
nearTermSpecifics: Atomic-write hardening (temp-file+rename under WRITE_LOCK) for exactly the files finalize touches: session_registry store, effort index, and the new usage ledger — landing BEFORE any finalize code exists
Finalize as compare-and-set: a cost_final flag keyed by session_id set atomically with the record, so kill/close/reconcile racing each other produce exactly one finalized cost record
50× race stress test: concurrently fire kill/close/reconcile against one session 50 times, assert exactly one cost record and all indexes still parse

Fail-closed sidecar-root resolver in paths.py: under ANCHOR_DATA_DIR/healthcheck/test mode it RAISES rather than resolving the live home store unless ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR is explicitly set; STUB-GATE test spies the resolver and asserts the healthcheck walk never opens a real-home path
deferred: Atomic-write hardening for files OUTSIDE the finalize set (the broader rnd_registry/effort_history writes flagged in the architecture review): explicitly deferred to a separate hardening effort — this phase covers only what finalize touches

phases.name: Phase 2 — Narration Backfill + Passive Warm Tile View
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (4),(5): 'any tile narrates' becomes true on day one via a render, not a model call — the passive view needs zero PTY and zero engine turns, so it ships before the cost pipeline and independently removes the blank-window failure mode for plain clicks.
nearTermSpecifics: One-time summary BACKFILL: batch-summarize from persisted docs/transcripts through the runner seam (stubbed in tests, throttled live) for brownfield, pre-v7, general, and failed-summary sessions; measure coverage % on the real registry before/after and record it
Two-step tile affordance: click = PASSIVE warm view (no PTY, no engine turn, free); a distinct '▶ Resume live' control triggers the spawn path (wired fully in Phase 5)

Narration spine as pure render: 'what was done' = cached summary, 'what was produced' = doc-roles map with /report and /artifact links, 'what comes next' = durable NEXT-PROMPT.md / pending_paste shown paste-NOT-submit — all three from existing durable artifacts

Substantive degraded seed: when no cached summary exists even post-backfill, the warm view renders doc list + lane + dates + last transcript tail via the existing W3 synthesizer — 'degraded' never means blank
Reuse-not-sibling rule: a click on an effort with an already-live session focuses that session's window instead of spawning
deferred: Live-resume orientation execution (the plan-mode narration job) and the WS attach-ack handshake: Phase 5 — this phase only ships the passive side of the two-step affordance
Backfill of sessions whose transcripts AND docs are both gone: honestly reported as unrecoverable in the coverage measurement, not synthesized

phases.name: Phase 3 — Usage-Capture Pipeline (UUID-at-launch → ledger → eager finalize)
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (1),(3),(6): the core of the North Star — every interactive ConPTY session and every one-shot job leaves a machine-verified cost trail through ONE code path, finalized on every end path, structurally immune to double-counting.
nearTermSpecifics: Capture engine_session_id AT LAUNCH: watch the project slug dir for the new JSONL created within a tight window while holding the session lock (or parse the PTY banner per the Phase-0 spike), store the UUID on the registry record; a record without a captured UUID is honestly state='uncorrelated' — never mtime-guessed later

Sum-over-message-usage parser against the pinned Phase-0 fixture: session cost = Σ per-message usage blocks, with explicit states measured / partial-resumed-elsewhere / unmeasured — never a guessed total

Append-only usage LEDGER keyed by (engine_session_uuid, message_uuid/line-hash): a session's cost = sum of its attributed ledger lines; re-ingesting the same sidecar (engine-switch relaunch, continue-session history) is idempotent by key; invariant test: switch_engine mid-session yields total = A-part + B-part counted once

Eager finalize on EVERY end path — kill, close/park, drain, finish, reconcile-dead — copying the usage snapshot into .anchor/ so reconcile weeks later reads Anchor's own durable snapshot, never the prunable ~/.claude store
Heartbeat snapshot piggybacks the existing 120s session-autosave heartbeat (2026-07-07) — one periodic hook does transcript persist + usage snapshot; no second timer
job_runner unification: route the durable-job path's already-parsed stream-json usage (lane launches, Gandalf shards, summarizer runs) through the SAME ledger keyed by engine session UUID
STUB-GATE suite with the pinned sidecar fixture covering all end paths, run under the Phase-1 fail-closed seam (temp ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR)
deferred: Gemini/agy segment ingestion: the ledger schema carries an engine field per line, but only the Claude path is populated in this plan (fast-follow per idea 30)
Any retroactive cost attribution for pre-feature sessions: they surface as 'unmeasured (pre-feature session)' in Phase 4, never estimated

phases.name: Phase 4 — Rollup Honesty: measured truth, explicit 'unmeasured', no double-count
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (2),(3): the rollup's numbers become 'measured truth, not zero-by-omission' — discovered efforts still contribute exactly 0, unmeasured is visually distinct from $0.00, and the docs-plus-cost coexistence is pinned by test.
nearTermSpecifics: Rollup dedup pinned by test: one test persists docs (source=discovered) AND attaches a RUN cost record for the SAME session_id, asserting the rollup counts the cost exactly once and the discovered doc-effort contributes 0 — extending the effort_view session_id rule into the cost domain

Tokens+time as first-class measured truth; dollars OPTIONAL, shown only when the engine itself reported nonzero costUSD — render 'N tok · Xm (subscription)' on the Max-subscription host; the no-own-pricing-table rule is locked at plan level

'Unmeasured' as a first-class visual state: distinct badge/color vs $0.00/0-tok, hover text naming the reason from the finalize pipeline's reason ENUM (sidecar-pruned, uncorrelated, gemini-segment, pre-feature) — never free text
Capture-rate stamped on the rollup itself: 'measured 14/17 sessions (30d)' rendered next to the totals on the dashboard John looks at daily
Per-ENGINE-SEGMENT badge model: each segment measured/unmeasured independently; a mixed session shows 'partial (gemini segment unmeasured)' rather than a complete-looking Claude-only number
Boneyard entries carry the finalized cost block, so killed-to-Boneyard spend remains visible history
v4 rollup + v8 persist suites stay green UNMODIFIED except the tests the Phase-0 audit explicitly classified superseded
deferred: Actually measuring Gemini segments (the badge honestly says unmeasured until the fast-follow spike lands)
Any historical spend estimation for pruned sidecars: rendered as unmeasured-with-reason, never interpolated

phases.name: Phase 5 — Live Resume & Tile Reliability (B2 fixes + orientation per the locked fork)
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (4),(5): every tile class click-opens a non-blank window, and '▶ Resume live' orients via harness-enforced read-only narration while ACTION prompts stay paste-NOT-submit — implementing exactly the Phase-0 classifications and fork lock.
nearTermSpecifics: Fix each Phase-0-classified state-bug against its captured registry-state fixture (large-tile blank window, context-free blue restart, manual orientation) with a regression test per bug

WS attach-ack/replay-complete handshake for the race class: the terminal window renders only after the server acks the attach and signals replay-buffer-complete — blank-window elimination as a protocol property, not a timing hope

Orientation per the locked fork: read-only narration runs as a one-shot plan-mode job through job_runner (never a seeded turn on the live interactive PTY); its output prints what was done / produced / next in the terminal
Pinned test: no ACTION prompt is ever auto-submitted — the v10 pending-paste path is asserted un-flushed-without-Enter across resume, advance, and orientation

Orientation-session lifecycle tags: click-resumed sessions carry an origin marker the zombie-hunter live-owner computation treats as owned-for-N-minutes, then auto-park (graceful close, docs persisted)
Bounded parked-worktree budget with oldest-first graceful eviction (docs already persisted to main → eviction loses nothing) + a dashboard count
Playwright screenshot sign-off per tile class: running, parked-idle, done, failed, discovered/brownfield each click-open a non-blank window
deferred: Any richer window-manager rework beyond the attach-ack fix (tabbing, layouts): out of scope — only the blank/context-free failures named in criterion 4 are fixed
Auto-narration on the PASSIVE click path: permanently excluded by the fork lock, not deferred

phases.name: Phase 6 — Verification, Deploy, and the Measured Undercount
phases.rationale: Serves criteria (1),(6),(7): the trail is proven live — the healthcheck walks the new path fully stubbed, a non-model tripwire catches schema drift the pinned fixtures would mask, and the undercount claim moves from inferred to observed.
nearTermSpecifics: Healthcheck capture+finalize walk (check_rnd surface pattern): write the pinned fake sidecar fixture into a temp ANCHOR_SIDECAR_DIR, start/kill a stub session, assert a RUN cost record with the fixture's exact totals lands in the temp registry — fully stubbed, never :8777, never real home paths (Phase-1 seam enforced)

Live drift tripwire: a NON-model read-only parse of the most recent real sidecars already on disk; report.warn (never red, per the locked severity rule) when zero of the last N real session files yield usage — catching a CLI-upgrade schema rename

Deploy sign-off smoke run: one real interactive session, killed, asserting the rollup delta equals the sidecar's reported usage (tokens exact, time within tolerance) — the only place a REAL sidecar meets the parser outside the tripwire
Prospective undercount measurement: capture-rate on NEW sessions for one week post-deploy (target ≥90% of Claude-engine sessions measured), recorded in the execution log
Historical backfill reported as an explicit 'attributed / surviving / total' breakdown — never a single recovered-% headline built on pruned or misattributed sidecars
Before/after rollup comparison on at least one real project recorded in the execution log (criterion 7)
deferred: The one-week capture-rate window necessarily completes AFTER the build waves close — recorded as a scheduled follow-up in the execution log with an owner and date, not silently dropped
Gemini-path drift tripwire: added only when the fast-follow spike wires Gemini ingestion
